PA-2026-01487.summary: This is a request for a lumbar spine MRI without contrast (CPT 72148) for left lumbar radiculopathy in a 54-year-old member. All four criteria appear met: documented radiculopathy, about 7.6 weeks of PT plus about 8.4 weeks of naproxen, objective neurologic findings with persistent leg pain, and no lumbar MRI in claims history. No gaps were identified for the reviewer's attention.

evidence.quote: Kellgren-Lawrence grade 4.
Severe medial joint-space narrowing with bone-on-bone contact.

criteria.rationale: The right knee X-ray report documents Kellgren-Lawrence grade 4 with bone-on-bone contact.

evidence.quote: Started physical therapy on 08/20/2026 and completed 6 weeks.

criteria.rationale: The earliest documented nonsurgical treatment began 08/20/2026. From then to the 10/15/2026 note is 56 days, about 8 weeks. That is short of the required 12 weeks. No earlier conservative treatment is documented, even though pain is reported for 3 years.

PA-2026-01502.summary: This is a request for a right total knee arthroplasty (CPT 27447) for primary osteoarthritis in a 67-year-old male. Criteria C1 (KL grade 4 on X-ray), C3 (functional limitation), C4 (BMI 34.1) and C5 (no signs of infection) are met. C2 is not met: documented conservative treatment began 08/20/2026, about 8 weeks before the 10/15/2026 consult, so the reviewer may want to ask whether any earlier nonsurgical treatment was given during the 3-year pain history.

evidence.quote: Vitals: Height 5'5", weight 171 lb, BMI 28.4.
Problem list: Essential hypertension. Overweight. Prediabetes (A1c 6.0).
46 y/o F here to discuss weight.

criteria.rationale: Member is 46 years old with a BMI of 28.4, which is 27 or above. She also has a documented weight-related condition, essential hypertension, treated with lisinopril.

evidence.quote: Discussed diet and exercise.

criteria.rationale: The note only says diet and exercise were discussed. It does not name a program, describe a specific reduced-calorie diet or activity plan, or give a start date. Current participation is therefore not documented.

evidence.quote: No GLP-1 receptor agonist claims in this period.

criteria.rationale: The 12-month pharmacy history shows only lisinopril and explicitly states there are no GLP-1 receptor agonist claims. The clinical note mentions no other GLP-1 agents.
